title: Sterlite Tech shares in focus as firm secures US certification for AI data centre fibre assemblies - The Economic Times
text:
Sterlite Technologies secured US certification for its indoor optical fibre assemblies designed for AI data centres. The company is targeting Rs 20,000 crore revenue by FY29, while strong Q1 results and AI-led demand have driven a sharp rally in its shares.
